cand.title: The Enclave
cand.excerpt: The Tie states 2027 dates, 250-seat format and full buyout of Zel Punta Cana.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Daryl Simon, SVP of Events at The Tie according to the current profile heading and July 2026 role entry, is the strongest operational relationship target. The same profile retains a concurrent VP entry, so exact title merits confirmation. Joshua Frank, Co-Founder & CEO, is a verified executive escalation target. Their relevance to hotel discussions is inferred from their roles; neither is publicly verified as the Enclave hotel-contract signatory.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming: March 1–4, 2027, within the requested horizon. The event site’s 2027 agenda explicitly lists March 1 check-in/welcome reception and March 2–4 dates; the organizer’s July 22, 2026 announcement independently specifies the full activity dates. July 22 is the announcement date, not the event date. No 2028 edition was established.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: an all-inclusive beachfront retreat is directionally compatible with Wyndham Alltra Punta Cana, but this is not a 2027 sales opening. The hotel publishes 620 rooms and three modular meeting rooms totaling 380 m², with an event capacity of 200–300. A 250-executive programme would require a detailed room-set, AV and banquet review. The Enclave’s defining requirement is whole-resort exclusivity; a full buyout of a 620-room property may be commercially inefficient at its 250-executive attendance cap. Do not equate attendees with guestrooms or add an unsupported family-room estimate.
findings.venueCommitments: The Tie explicitly states it has reserved Zel Punta Cana in its entirety for a full-resort buyout. This is an organizer-announced commitment, not a preferred-hotel listing. Paradisus Palma Real is the announced connected accommodation option for attendees bringing children, with access wristbands; no room allotment or contract terms are published. The underlying hotel agreement was not reviewed.
findings.historicalRotation: The organizer describes The Enclave as a new second invitational gathering alongside, not replacing, Out East. It replaces The Tie’s annual ETH Denver-week gathering. InnovateDenver’s published 2026 event date was February 18 in Denver, Colorado, and it was described as the third annual edition. This is predecessor-program context, not proof of previous Enclave editions or a rotating Caribbean series. No historical Enclave host-hotel timeline or verified annual Enclave recurrence was established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: 2027 primary resort sourcing is committed to Zel; no public open hotel RFP was found. The Tie controls attendee approval: approved applicants receive a purchase link, and the published all-inclusive institutional ticket is USD 3,500, with additional family charges. The public ticket page does not specify room nights, occupancy, room allocations or a hotel booking code. The announced family pathway is Paradisus Palma Real, not Wyndham Alltra. Terms identify events@thetie.io as an event customer-service contact; this is not evidence of procurement authority. No named external PCO, DMC or hotel-sourcing agency was established.
findings.organizationStructure: The Tie is a corporate institutional digital-assets platform and the event presenter/organizer, not an association or a disclosed PCO/DMC. Event terms identify The Tie Inc. Zel is the host resort; Paradisus Palma Real is the announced family accommodation option. The actual programme is financial-services/crypto executive networking, not sports or entertainment despite the supplied segment label.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Zel already provides the selected all-inclusive, full-property private setting. The organizer also advertises connected family accommodation at Paradisus Palma Real with event access. That is an incumbent family solution, not evidence of overflow or sold-out inventory. No unmet room demand, waitlist, overflow block or Wyndham participation was established. Wyndham’s published size and meeting capacity require commercial and operational testing before proposing an equivalent exclusive retreat.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Daryl Simon first, with Joshua Frank as executive escalation; use the published events@thetie.io inbox for routing if necessary, acknowledging that it is listed for event customer service. Explicitly recognize the Zel commitment rather than sending an unsolicited 2027 room-block quote. Ask whether Enclave will recur, who owns hotel sourcing, when incumbent renewal/alternative-site decisions occur, and whether whole-resort exclusivity is non-negotiable. Offer a concise future-edition concept only if a competitive window and suitable exclusivity model are confirmed; then validate plenary, dining, guestrooms and buyout economics. Do not forecast 2028 demand yet.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Low for Wyndham Alltra guestrooms: the March 2027 venue is announced and committed elsewhere. Attendee applications are accessible subject to The Tie approval, but open ticket requests do not mean hotel procurement is open. Do not place the 250-attendee figure into Wyndham’s room pipeline or represent family accommodation as an available overflow opportunity.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development prospect only. Replacing an annual Denver-week gathering shows organizer programme continuity, but does not verify annual Enclave recurrence, a 2028 date, venue rotation, or a competitive procurement window. Explore whether a later edition could accept a private enclave or partial-property model; such a model would depart from the advertised full-buyout proposition and needs explicit organizer acceptance.
